note: Choose a trail T with the maximum number of edges. Endpoint-incidence parity shows T is closed. If T omits an edge, connectedness gives a vertex v of T incident to an unused edge. In the residual graph of unused edges, every vertex has even degree because T is closed. A longest residual trail beginning at v is nonempty and must close at v by the same endpoint parity argument. Splicing it into T gives a longer trail, contradiction.
